summary: Frontend-only re-test of the 3 fixes + regression sanity (as requested; backend pytest suite NOT re-run). VERIFIED FIXED: (1) Global period filter - admin login now shows filter-month='9' (September) and filter-year='2026' matching header 'Periode September 2026'; changing month to Agustus updates header to 'Periode Agustus 2026' (correct, no more corrupted '09-08') and re-queries the API (KPIs correctly go to Rp 0 / N/A because only 2026-09 is seeded); year change to 2025 on Target & Achievement re-queried and rendered 'periode 2025-09' with '-' values; reverting to September restores real data (Lending Rp 4,93 M / 86,5%, Funding Rp 9,38 M / 97,7%, NPF 2,7%, ranking Rizky 113,0% Excellent). (2) Collection activity submitted WITHOUT a photo now renders Validasi='Lokasi Tidak Tersedia' (was 'Valid'). (3) Token-protected /api/files/{path}?auth=<token> gallery images load - HTTP 200, img naturalWidth=600, watermark overlay visible. Regression: all 5 role logins redirect correctly (direktur->/executive with 6 charts + NPF score 111,9; admin->/admin; ao_lending->/dashboard 113,0% Excellent; ao_funding 115,0%; pic_remedial 117,6% + NPF page with 4 kol 3-5 accounts), leaderboard 3 tabs (4/4/2 rows), portfolio kolek 1-5 cards all populated. No JS console errors other than the expected 401 from GET /api/auth/me before login.
